profile.subtitleJa: ダビデに加わった一団の指導者
profile.summaryJa: 1歴代誌12:18は、ダビデの陣営へ来た者たちの指導者としてアマサイを挙げます。彼はダビデへの忠誠を表明し、受け入れられます。
profile.identityNoteJa: 記事は12:18のダビデ側についた指導者を6章のレビ人と区別します。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.
